class FooTest {
    @Test
    void runs() throws Exception {
        new Thread(() -> work()).start(); // bad
        Thread t = new Thread(() -> work());
        t.start(); // bad
        executor.submit(() -> work()); // bad
        Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2).execute(() -> work()); // bad
        CompletableFuture.runAsync(() -> work()); // bad
    }
}
